question: This is an AI-generated 'Aura Walk' streetwear promo for a t-shirt brand (JAYL). Evaluate it critically for: camera movement and framing variety (fisheye/zoom/strange angles), model movement and expressions, whether a chest-emblem t-shirt stays sharp/undistorted, lighting/chiaroscuro, any aura/glow effect, pacing/shot count, and AI artifacts (face/hands/logo warping). What concretely should be improved?
